name: Veteran's Cane

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Become a Longsword
powers.text: Bonus Action: the cane becomes an ordinary longsword and loses its magic.

summary: A walking cane that turns into an ordinary longsword (and stays one).
text: When you grasp this walking cane and use a Bonus Action to speak the command word, it transforms into an ordinary Longsword and ceases to be magical.
